scripts.dev:cloudflare: pnpm setup:local --runtime cloudflare && node scripts/check-dev-ports.mjs --runtime cloudflare && pnpm config:check --runtime cloudflare --config apps/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc --allow-placeholders && pnpm build:portal && pnpm db:migrate:cloudflare:local && pnpm db:seed:cloudflare:local && concurrently -k -n cloudflare,portal "pnpm dev:cloudflare:server" "pnpm dev:portal"
scripts.dev:vps: pnpm setup:local --runtime vps && node scripts/check-dev-ports.mjs --runtime vps && pnpm db:migrate:vps --database data/infini-guild.sqlite && pnpm db:seed:vps --database data/infini-guild.sqlite && concurrently -k -n vps,portal "pnpm dev:vps:server" "pnpm dev:portal"
scripts.dev:vps:server: pnpm config:check --runtime vps --config apps/vps/.env && node --env-file=apps/vps/.env --import tsx apps/vps/src/index.ts
scripts.start:vps: pnpm config:check --runtime vps --config apps/vps/.env && node --env-file=apps/vps/.env apps/vps/dist/server.mjs
scripts.build:cloudflare: pnpm config:check --runtime cloudflare --config apps/cloudflare/wrangler.example.jsonc --allow-placeholders && pnpm typecheck:cloudflare && pnpm build:portal && esbuild apps/cloudflare/src/index.ts --bundle --platform=browser --target=es2022 --format=esm --conditions=workerd,worker,browser --external:node:async_hooks --outfile=apps/cloudflare/dist/worker.mjs
scripts.build:vps: pnpm typecheck:vps && pnpm build:portal && esbuild apps/vps/src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node26 --format=esm --outfile=apps/vps/dist/server.mjs
scripts.release:check: node scripts/check-no-secrets.mjs --ci && pnpm check:legacy && pnpm check:boundaries && pnpm config:check --runtime cloudflare --config apps/cloudflare/wrangler.example.jsonc --allow-placeholders && pnpm config:check --runtime vps --config scripts/templates/vps.env.example --allow-placeholders && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build:cloudflare && pnpm build:vps
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: pnpm config:check --runtime cloudflare --config apps/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc && pnpm release:check && wrangler deploy --config apps/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc
